messages:
mira (PM): Heads-up: drafting post-GA iteration policy. Need fast rules for hotfix vs backlog. My strawman: hotfix if data loss, security, outage, or >20% unit-cost regression. Otherwise triage into next mini-iteration but reserve a small fast-lane for at-risk customers.
alex (ENG): Agree. Add error-rate spikes and persistent timeouts to hotfix list. Also want a simple checkbox in the bug template: 'hotfix requested' + reason.
jen (PD): Fast-lane: allow up to 15% of cycle for paying-customer asks with PD sign-off and a 1-2 metric success definition.
sofia (SRE): SLA proposal: acknowledge within 1h; triage label + severity. Target patch window: 24h for critical, 72h for high. Also set automated canary rollback thresholds.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout: hotfix/1721000000 -> 10% traffic. Monitors: p99 latency, error-rate, cost-per-token.
mira (PM): Action items: Alex -> add checklist to template; Jen -> draft fast-lane form; Sofia -> add SLA + rollback to runbook. I'll assemble the doc once items land. Sound good?
alex (ENG): Yep, will PR checklist today.
jen (PD): On it.
sofia (SRE): Scheduling brief runbook update.
mira (PM): Thanks team. Posting draft in #product when ready. :thumbsup:
